meaning: FIT_START sets the six-parameter starting point for the log-space Nelder-Mead fit in fits/m3/Model_5/fit.jl:358. Because the search is relative to each parameter's own start, this vector fixes both where the simplex begins and the scale of its first steps.

could_move.what: Fitted values of all six FIT_NAMES parameters, since Nelder-Mead on a non-convex objective can land in a different local minimum from a different start
Penalty/clamp behaviour near bounds, especially Psinus_v whose start (7.0*MMHG) sits well above FIT_LO 0.0 — the comment says this is the one that bites
Any m5 patient fit deck comparing model to recording
Downstream m1-vs-m5 and m4-vs-m5 figure decks in the CIS report (jug-* figures)

expectation: Unknown in size. Direction is not predictable from the code alone: log-space relative steps mean a changed start rescales the simplex, so fitted values may shift a little or converge to a different basin. Whether the m5 fits stay comparable to m1/m4 cannot be told without re-running.

check.why: Re-checks one stored m5 fit against its recording without paying for a full re-fit, so a start-point change that moved the optimum shows up as a changed score or parameter set.
